title: 육군인사사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Commander, etc.)
(1) The Army Personnel Command (hereinafter referred to as the "Personnel Command") shall have a Commander and a Deputy Commander.
(2) The Commander and the Deputy Commander shall be appointed from among general-grade officers of the Army. <Amended on September 5, 2017>
(3) The Commander shall, under the orders of the Chief of Staff of the Army, exercise overall control over the affairs of the Personnel Command and command and supervise its staff departments and subordinate units.
(4) The Deputy Commander shall assist the Commander and act on behalf of the Commander where the Commander is unable to perform his or her duties due to unavoidable circumstances.
